text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
During lunch today, Air Groove comes<n>over to ask
Mejiro Dober about<n>essential oils.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: For headaches, lavender and<n>bergamot are best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I recommend you use them with a<n>clay mask
before bed. It'll help you<n>relax.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A clay mask... Thanks. I'll give it a try.<n>You're even
more knowledgeable<n>than I heard you were.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who did you hear about me<n>from?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Me, of course! I went an' told<n>everyone how smart
you are, Dober!
Taiki?! But it's not as if I know thatmuch about essential oils...

Don't be so modest! You know<n>everythin' from
beauty care to<n>healthy habits, study hacks, and
even<n>sleeping tips!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone needs to know how much<n>learnin' ya
got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it makes me happy to hear<n>you say that,
but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Excuse me? Dober, you know a<n>lot about
essential oils, right?
...I know a little. How can I help you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm actually asking on Spe's<n>behalf. Her poor
stomach is always<n>growling, and I was wondering
if<n>there are oils that suppress hunger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Suppress hunger? I've heard of ones<n>that boost
appetite, but let's see... I<n>suppose something minty
would<n>help...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following this, countless students<n>start consulting
Mejiro Dober about<n>their troubles.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I never seem to get enough sleep.<n>Are there any
essential oils that<n>promote better sleep or
something?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I want one that keeps you wide<n>awake! I know
someone who's<n>dozing off all the time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Settle down, you two. You should both<n>use some
geranium oil to help calm<n>your nerves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
For muscle pain, I recommend using a<n>beeswax
cream mixed with lavender<n>and tea tree oil.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Beeswax? Ooh, I wonder if the wax<n>will have any
honey left on it? Sounds<n>delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It won't, so don't try to eat it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After having to deal with an endless<n>stream of
queries, Mejiro Dober is<n>exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whew... I can finally take a break...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: N-not really. It's not that big of a deal.

Hehe, thanks. I just hope I was able<n>to help

The aromas help me relax and forget<n>about all the

text_block_list.text:
I had no idea there'd be such a<n>demand for my
expertise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should learn even more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What are you so happy about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You think? Then maybe I will. It'd be<n>nice to be able
to help others more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What, do you have something you<n>want to ask me
too?

What I use? Oh, I don't want to talk<n>about myself.

text_block_list.text: Wait, are you really that sad that I<n>won't answer?

I suppose I can tell you the shop I<n>frequent...

text_block_list.text: The staff there are pretty nice...

Dober recommended,<n>when...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. You.

Why don't we go together since<n>we're both here?
I'll help you pick<n>some that suit your needs.

...You're horrible at managing your<n>sleep schedule
and maintaining a<n>balanced diet.

You've been sleep-deprived because<n>of work
lately, and I've been worried<n>about whether you're
eating<n>properly...

of your life first.

to help you relax.

text_block_list.text:
But since you're always at your<n>desk, I bet your
back is under a lot of<n>pressure too. Eucalyptus and
rosemary might help with that...

text_block_list.text: You didn't understand anything I justsaid, did you? Sigh. Just go back toyour office for now...
